assessments.fundamentals: AMIC combines leasing, poultry, water treatment, distribution and property investments [portfolio]. Visually inspected Q1 2026 consolidated statements show parent-attributable profit about EGP 205.4m versus EGP 31.3m a year earlier, but operating cash flow is negative (approximately EGP 380.3m). Leasing receivables and funding flows complicate interpretation; profit growth alone does not establish distributable holding-company cash [statement]. TradingView snapshot P/E 23.40, P/B 5.64 and ROE 28.66% are provider TTM/FQ metrics, not a reconciled sum-of-parts valuation. Need H1 2026 statements, subsidiary ownership/NAV, related-party exposures, debt maturities and recurring versus disposal/revaluation earnings before a value conclusion. Do not compare AMIA to commercial banks using the frozen Finance median.
